title: Choose the brand world
question: This roll ran degraded (no challengers or quality boards could load). Keep The House Record, take the pick, or re-roll.

options.label: The House Record
options.thesis: Every home and town is recorded like a survey sheet — photograph, address, period, materials — then written about like it matters.
options.viewport: A slate survey sheet: HOME IS PERSONAL. as field 01, a Worcester County house photo in its field box, the brand book's chapters as numbered fields.
options.risk: Reads bureaucratic if the forms aren't warmed by photography and the serif voice.

options.label: The Quarterly
options.thesis: The brand as an independent architecture quarterly: cover, contents, long reads, photo spreads.
options.viewport: A magazine cover: a cropped interior photograph, HOME IS PERSONAL. as the cover line, issue-style contents down the side.
options.risk: Also where most runs in this category land: warm off-white, serif display, hairlines.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What luxury brokerage sites ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed aerial photo with a centered search bar, then a featured-listing grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every brokerage template — the brief rules this out.
